startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Public pages to read. The Actor skips any URL that the site's robots.txt disallows.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many results. Each result is charged once.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Maximum requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Polite rate limit per website. Keep it low; the Actor also honours Retry-After and backs off on errors.
